title: The projected Hessian trace removes the radial term
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: The projected Hessian trace removes the radial term. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: Let $w$ be a unit vector in a real Euclidean space with finite coordinate set $I$, let $(e_j)_{j\in I}$ be its coordinate basis, and let $f$ be a real ambient test function. Write $p_j=e_j-w_jw$. The trace of the ambient second Fréchet derivative evaluated on the pairs $(p_j,p_j)$ equals the ambient Laplacian minus the radial Hessian entry.
